input.title: MX2 LLC amends circuit breaker resumption rules for 23-hour trading
input.summary: MX2 LLC filed a rule change with immediate effectiveness to amend Rule 11.23 governing resumption of trading after a Level 3 market-wide circuit breaker halt, in connection with the industry's expansion of trading hours to 23 hours per day, 5 days per week.
evidence_quotes: Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 11.23 Concerning the Resumption of Trading Following a Level 3 Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Halt in Connection With the Industry's Expansion of Trading Hours to 23 Hours per Day, 5 Days per Week
input.notes: headline_only. This rule change is directly connected to the 23-hour/5-day trading expansion already recorded as EV0003 (NSCC 24x5 clearing go-live). It addresses how Level 3 market-wide circuit breaker halts and trading resumptions are handled under the expanded hours regime, touching both ECS-SET-01 (settlement cycle/trading hours changes) and XE-DISRUPT (market disruption/halt procedures). MX2 LLC is a single exchange SRO, so reach is set to 1 (business_line) rather than market_wide, as the rule change is one participant's adaptation to the broader industry change. No new information beyond what is in EV0003 regarding the 24x5 expansion itself, but this is a distinct regulatory action (circuit breaker resumption rules) not previously recorded.
